newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Sateras, UCI jump on requotes.
newsitem.headline: Sateras, UCI jump on requotes.

text.p: Shares of Sateras Resources (Malaysia) Bhd and United Chemical Industries Bhd (UCI) rose sharply on Wednesday on requotation.
Around 20 minutes into the opening, Sateras stock was up 9.48 percent or 20 cents to 2.31 ringgit on 3.36 million shares traded.
UCI, which will hold a majority stake in Sateras after a restructuring, jumped 7.69 percent or 1.40 ringgit to 19.60 with 958,000 shares traded.
Sateras announced last week it was buying two pieces of land and an integrated cement plant for 800 million ringgit from UCI.
One of the pieces of land holds an integrated cement plant which is under construction the other is an industrial land.
Sateras said the acquisitions will be paid by the issue of 320 million new shares at 2.50 ringgit each to UCI.

At the end of the exercise, UCI, previously a plastic products maker, would own 41.3 percent of the enlarged paid up capital of Sateras. UCI received the land and cement assets from just-acquired Hongkew Holdings (M) Sdn Bhd.
